zh.summary: 修复内置组件目录冲突导致的启动失败，新增 Windows 独立诊断修复入口。
highlights: 启动时可恢复被物化为普通目录的内置桥接和插件市场组件，原目录保留在 data/recovery；未知内容不会覆盖。启动、诊断和修复统一检查组件链接状态，避免路径存在却无法启动时仍显示正常。
Windows 包新增 DSH-Recovery.exe，主界面无法打开时仍可检查运行文件、诊断、修复可重建组件和导出支持报告。
RC 使用独立的官方内核验收目录，避免与稳定版的兼容清单混用；目录尚未发布时显示等待提示。
插件安装和更新在启用前检查模块加载；发现导入错误或超时会报告原因并尝试恢复此前的插件状态。
迁移可选择仅会话与设置，不带插件安装配置和凭据文件；Portable 版本选择始终显示当前版本。
upgradeNotes: 这是候选版，稳定通道仍为 0.6.4。升级前请退出程序并保留数据备份。
独立工具的深层诊断需要包内 Node 和启动脚本完整；缺失时会提示使用完整离线包恢复。
#132 的用户侧验证仍在等待反馈；本版不承诺恢复会话分组或完成 automode 插件兼容性验证。

en.summary: Recover from built-in component directory conflicts and add an independent Windows recovery entry point.
highlights: Materialized desktop bridge and plugin market directories can be recovered at startup; originals are retained under data/recovery. Unknown content is preserved unchanged. Startup, diagnostics and repair share component link checks, avoiding false healthy results for conflicting paths.
Windows packages include DSH-Recovery.exe for file checks, diagnostics, generated-component repair and support reports without opening the desktop UI.
Release candidates use isolated qualified core catalogs instead of mixing stable-shell compatibility metadata; unpublished catalogs show a waiting message.
Plugin installations and updates check module imports before activation; import failures or timeouts report the cause and attempt to restore the previous plugin state.
The bundled official core is updated to 0.1.5-rc.1.
Migration can export sessions and settings without plugin installation configuration or credential files; the Portable version selector always shows the current version.
upgradeNotes: This is a release candidate. The stable channel remains on 0.6.4. Exit the application and keep a backup before upgrading.
Deep diagnostics require the bundled Node runtime and launcher scripts. Missing files lead to full-package recovery guidance.
Reporter verification for #132 is pending. Session grouping recovery and automode compatibility have not been qualified.
